workItem.title: Characterize opaque proxy statuses without inspecting them
workItem.body:
Append one characterization test for the accepted summarize contract; preserve production behavior.

Acceptance for implementation and integration:
- Append one test to src/summary.test.mjs, preserving all 33 existing tests byte-for-byte as a prefix and preserving src/summary.mjs exactly.
- Use a frozen four-item inventory with exact primitive passed and failed statuses, a frozen opaque object proxy whose get trap throws and records any access, and a frozen null-prototype object status. Expect literal counters total=4, passed=1, failed=1, unavailable=2, with zero proxy property accesses and no coercion.
- Verify the inventory and each status identity remain unchanged. Execute the declared candidate commands through the trusted host and cite actual receipts. Published-branch validation and forge CI are subsequent host gates; report them as pending before publication.
- Preserve accepted product models, provider scaffolds, existing guidance, implementation policy and workflow configuration. Planning artifacts for this issue are allowed; the accepted product definition covers this behavior.

Later operator qualification for Lighthouse #567: an isolated transport pause will hold the original automatic final-review dispatch while main advances through one documentation-only commit. The unchanged admission guard must reject the old revision before agent/publisher execution. Trusted preparation must signal the existing maintenance workflow; it must confirm terminal native jobs and create at most one linked review retry without owner action, another merge, another original CI or ProductShape apply. This observation occurs after implementation/integration and must not block those earlier stages. The transport control itself grants no additional lifecycle permission.
